The model should consist of two spheres, one conductive and the other resistive, compared to the background. The inversion should be restrained to the Core Mesh using an Active Cells mapping combined with an exponential mapping to invert in log conductivity space. The code should also include the creation of a synthetic Dipole-Dipole Survey and a Tikhonov Inversion. Finally, the code should generate a plot of the ground truth and the inverted model, both vertically and horizontally.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
A, _aHd, _derivA, casing_a, _aSrc, getA, _makeASymmetric, getADeriv, inversion, test_update_of_sparse_norms, _mirror_mapping_to_objfctlist, ValidationInInversion, ParametrizedCasingAndLayer, _aHd_uV, getADeriv_mu, getADeriv_sigma, getADeriv_mui, getADeriv_rho, _mirror_model_to_objfcts, toRecArray

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from discretize import TensorMesh
from SimPEG import maps, data, data_misfit, regularization, optimization, inverse_problem, inversion, directives
from SimPEG.electromagnetics.static import resistivity as dc
from SimPEG.utils import mkvc

# Mesh parameters
cs, ncx, ncy, ncz, npad = 5.0, 40, 40, 20, 10
hx = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncx), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hy = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncy), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hz = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncz)]
mesh = TensorMesh([hx, hy, hz], x0="CCC")

# Model parameters
background_conductivity = 1e-2  # S/m
sphere1_center = np.array([0, -20, -30])
sphere1_radius = 12
sphere1_conductivity = 1e-1  # conductive sphere

sphere2_center = np.array([15, 15, -25])
sphere2_radius = 8
sphere2_conductivity = 1e-3  # resistive sphere

# Define model
xyz = mesh.gridCC
r1 = np.linalg.norm(xyz - sphere1_center, axis=1)
r2 = np.linalg.norm(xyz - sphere2_center, axis=1)
model = np.ones(mesh.nC) * background_conductivity
model[r1 < sphere1_radius] = sphere1_conductivity
model[r2 < sphere2_radius] = sphere2_conductivity

# Define core region for inversion
core = (
    (mesh.gridCC[:, 0] > -cs * ncx / 2)
    & (mesh.gridCC[:, 0] < cs * ncx / 2)
    & (mesh.gridCC[:, 1] > -cs * ncy / 2)
    & (mesh.gridCC[:, 1] < cs * ncy / 2)
    & (mesh.gridCC[:, 2] < 0)
    & (mesh.gridCC[:, 2] > -cs * ncz)
)
active = core

# Mapping: active cells + expMap (log conductivity)
actMap = maps.InjectActiveCells(mesh, active, np.log(background_conductivity))
expMap = maps.ExpMap()
mapping = expMap * actMap

# Survey geometry: Dipole-Dipole
n_electrodes = 24
xmin, xmax = -80, 80
y_electrodes = 0.0
z_electrodes = 0.0
electrode_locations = np.c_[
    np.linspace(xmin, xmax, n_electrodes),
    np.ones(n_electrodes) * y_electrodes,
    np.ones(n_electrodes) * z_electrodes,
]

source_list = []
for i in range(n_electrodes - 3):
    for n_spacing in range(1, 4):
        A = electrode_locations[i]
        B = electrode_locations[i + 1]
        M = electrode_locations[i + 1 + n_spacing]
        N = electrode_locations[i + 2 + n_spacing]
        src = dc.sources.Dipole(
            [dc.receivers.Dipole(M, N)], A, B
        )
        source_list.append(src)
survey = dc.survey.Survey(source_list)

# Simulation
simulation = dc.simulation.Simulation3DNodal(
    mesh,
    survey=survey,
    sigma=model,
    solver=dc.utils.SolverLU,
)

# Generate synthetic data
synthetic_data = simulation.dpred()
std = 0.03  # 3% noise
noise = std * np.abs(synthetic_data) * np.random.randn(synthetic_data.size)
dobs = synthetic_data + noise

# Set up inversion problem
data_obj = data.Data(survey, dobs=dobs, standard_deviation=std * np.abs(dobs) + 1e-5)

simulation_invert = dc.simulation.Simulation3DNodal(
    mesh,
    survey=survey,
    sigmaMap=mapping,
    solver=dc.utils.SolverLU,
)

dmis = data_misfit.L2DataMisfit(simulation=simulation_invert, data=data_obj)
reg = regularization.Simple(mesh, indActive=active)
opt = optimization.InexactGaussNewton(maxIter=15)
inv_prob = inverse_problem.BaseInvProblem(dmis, reg, opt)
betaest = directives.BetaEstimate_ByEig(beta0_ratio=1e0)
target = directives.TargetMisfit()
save = directives.SaveOutputEveryIteration()
inv = inversion.BaseInversion(inv_prob, directiveList=[betaest, target, save])

# Initial model (log conductivity)
m0 = np.log(np.ones(active.sum()) * background_conductivity)

# Run inversion
recovered_model = inv.run(m0)

# Map models to full mesh
recovered_sigma = np.ones(mesh.nC) * background_conductivity
recovered_sigma[active] = np.exp(recovered_model)
true_sigma = model

# Plotting
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

# Vertical cross-section (Y=0)
y_ind = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.vectorCCy - 0))
im0 = axes[0, 0].imshow(
    np.log10(true_sigma.reshape(mesh.vnC)[:, y_ind, :].T),
    extent=[
        mesh.vectorCCx[0],
        mesh.vectorCCx[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCz[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCz[0],
    ],
    aspect="auto",
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[0, 0].set_title("True Model (Vertical, Y=0)")
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel("X (m)")
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("Z (m)")
plt.colorbar(im0, ax=axes[0, 0], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

im1 = axes[0, 1].imshow(
    np.log10(recovered_sigma.reshape(mesh.vnC)[:, y_ind, :].T),
    extent=[
        mesh.vectorCCx[0],
        mesh.vectorCCx[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCz[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCz[0],
    ],
    aspect="auto",
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[0, 1].set_title("Inverted Model (Vertical, Y=0)")
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel("X (m)")
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel("Z (m)")
plt.colorbar(im1, ax=axes[0, 1], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

# Horizontal slice (Z = -30 m)
z_ind = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.vectorCCz + 30))
im2 = axes[1, 0].imshow(
    np.log10(true_sigma.reshape(mesh.vnC)[:, :, z_ind].T),
    extent=[
        mesh.vectorCCx[0],
        mesh.vectorCCx[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCy[0],
        mesh.vectorCCy[-1],
    ],
    aspect="auto",
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[1, 0].set_title("True Model (Horizontal, Z=-30m)")
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("X (m)")
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel("Y (m)")
plt.colorbar(im2, ax=axes[1, 0], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

im3 = axes[1, 1].imshow(
    np.log10(recovered_sigma.reshape(mesh.vnC)[:, :, z_ind].T),
    extent=[
        mesh.vectorCCx[0],
        mesh.vectorCCx[-1],
        mesh.vectorCCy[0],
        mesh.vectorCCy[-1],
    ],
    aspect="auto",
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[1, 1].set_title("Inverted Model (Horizontal, Z=-30m)")
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("X (m)")
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel("Y (m)")
plt.colorbar(im3, ax=axes[1, 1], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
